mapper.select: SELECT b.booth_id , b.name , b.category , b.target_animal , b.intro , bi.booth_item_id , bi.name AS item_name , bi.type AS item_type , bi.note AS item_note FROM booth b JOIN application a ON b.application_id = a.application_id LEFT JOIN booth_item bi ON bi.booth_id = b.booth_id WHERE a.fair_id = #{fairId} ORDER BY b.booth_id
